candidate_sentence_map.S1: AB Pieno Žvaigždės reported a significant improvement in financial performance for the first quarter of 2026 compared to the same period in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The company achieved total revenue of 52,064 thousand EUR, which represents a slight decrease of approximately 0.5 percent from the 52,324 thousand EUR recorded in the first quarter of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Despite the marginal decline in top-line sales, the company demonstrated enhanced operational efficiency and profitability.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The cost of sales decreased substantially to 38,078 thousand EUR from 42,530 thousand EUR in the prior year period.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: This reduction in costs drove a substantial increase in gross profit, which rose to 13,986 thousand EUR, up from 9,794 thousand EUR in the first quarter of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: This represents a growth of approximately 42.8 percent in gross profit.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Operating performance also showed marked improvement.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Operating profit before finance costs reached 3,366 thousand EUR, a significant increase from the 535 thousand EUR reported in the same period last year.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: This improvement was supported by higher gross margins, partially offset by an increase in sales and administrative expenses, which rose to 10,983 thousand EUR from 9,287 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Finance costs remained relatively stable, with net finance expenses of 298 thousand EUR compared to 308 thousand EUR in the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Consequently, profit before tax surged to 3,068 thousand EUR from just 227 thousand EUR in the first quarter of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The company recorded a net profit of 3,068 thousand EUR, resulting in earnings per share of 0.07 EUR, compared to 0.01 EUR in the prior year period.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: EBITDA also more than doubled, reaching 4,730 thousand EUR from 2,001 thousand EUR.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Regarding the financial position, total assets increased to 85,305 thousand EUR at the end of March 2026 from 83,475 thousand EUR at the end of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Total equity grew to 41,164 thousand EUR, up from 38,238 thousand EUR, primarily due to the retention of earnings.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The current ratio improved to 1.51 from 1.27, indicating stronger short-term liquidity.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Cash and cash equivalents increased to 2,157 thousand EUR from 1,806 thousand EUR at the end of the previous year.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Net cash flow from operating activities was positive at 1,625 thousand EUR, a stark contrast to the negative cash flow of negative 183 thousand EUR in the first quarter of 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Investing activities used 551 thousand EUR, while financing activities used 723 thousand EUR, largely due to loan repayments.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: The company continues to operate primarily in the domestic Lithuanian market and other EU countries, with fresh milk products remaining the largest sales category.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: No material post-balance sheet events occurred during the reporting period.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1-K7 are all PRESENT with clear representation in the candidate summary.
